title: Stoicism and Epicureanism
learning_outcomes: Explain stoic aims in the context of stoicism and epicureanism.
Compare and distinguish epicurean aims in the context of stoicism and epicureanism.
Apply control and influence in the context of stoicism and epicureanism.
Evaluate and justify decisions about practical limits in the context of stoicism and epicureanism.

lessons.title: Stoic aims
lessons.outcome: Explain stoic aims in the context of stoicism and epicureanism.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving stoic aims; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to two-perspective dilemma.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain stoic aims from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of stoic aims; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Epicurean aims
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish epicurean aims in the context of stoicism and epicureanism.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving epicurean aims; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to two-perspective dilemma.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain epicurean aims from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of epicurean aims; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Control and influence
lessons.outcome: Apply control and influence in the context of stoicism and epicureanism.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving control and influence; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to two-perspective dilemma.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain control and influence from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of control and influence; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Practical limits
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about practical limits in the context of stoicism and epicureanism.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving practical limits; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to two-perspective dilemma.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain practical limits from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of practical limits; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of stoic aims; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of epicurean aims; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of control and influence; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of practical limits; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Philosopher or scholar of relevant tradition; avoid treating one tradition as universal.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
